A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with 17 readable pages including Appendices A–I. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support comparison of all scientific content, equations, figures, and tables.

before.justification: v1.pdf reports original EEG classification experiments, ablations, statistical analyses, and computational measurements in Section 6 and Appendices F–I.

after.justification: v3.pdf retains the original classification results, ablations, statistical analyses, and computational measurements in Section 6 and Appendices F–I.

M1.justification: The balanced signed graph construction, unrolled low-pass filtering, contrastive training objective, and classification using two denoisers' reconstruction errors are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the Turkish Epilepsy EEG Dataset under default and leave-one-subject-out settings and the TUH Abnormal EEG Corpus in Appendix G. No dataset or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within corresponding experiments, including the default and LOSO comparisons in Table 1, TUH comparisons in Table 7, and EEGNet, FBCSPNet, and Deep4Net comparisons in Tables 8 and 10.

E3.justification: The 8:1:1 default split, LOSO protocol, TUH 70:30 split, preprocessing, evaluation metrics, model configurations, and training settings are unchanged.

E4.justification: Both versions contain identical graph-type ablations in Table 2 and loss, sequence-length, CNN-block-count, and distance-metric analyses in Tables 3–6. The supplementary generalization and computational analyses are also retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Appendix H retains 100 experiments across ten random partitions with ten randomly initialized runs each, mean and standard-deviation reporting, paired t-tests, and the LOSO ANOVA analysis. No statistical reporting practice or run information changes.

E6.justification: All result entries in Tables 1–10 and accompanying findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains 97.57% default accuracy and 90.06% LOSO accuracy, and Table 7 retains 90.69% TUH accuracy.

T1.justification: Mathematical definitions, assumptions, and equations are unchanged, including the graph-balance formulation, denoising derivations, Lanczos approximation, and reconstruction-error justification in Appendices B–D.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about interpretability, balanced signed graph denoising, competitive EEG classification, and parameter efficiency.

C2.justification: Results receive the same interpretations in both versions. The binary-classification limitation in Section 7 and the electrode-montage restriction on cross-dataset validation in Appendix H are unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 6.1 and Appendix E retain the same implementation, preprocessing, optimizer, learning-rate schedule, batch size, hardware, and training details. Code and data access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: The 43 references and research positioning are identical, including the relationship to earlier graph-based unrolling methods and denoiser pretext tasks discussed in Appendix A.

P1.justification: The author block corrects 'New Your University' to 'New York University' and replaces street addresses with countries. Dates and version headers are updated; scientific prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The first-page author layout changes from two rows of three authors to rows of four and two, slightly shifting the text below. Figures 1–2 and Tables 1–10 are unchanged; rendered pages 2–17 differ only in the header date.

improvement.justification: v3.pdf makes a small affiliation correction and updates front-page layout and dates. The scientific text, evidence, analysis, limitations, and reproducibility information remain identical throughout the main text and Appendices A–I, leaving overall paper quality materially unchanged.
